declarant_role: human owner of the selected AURA code
ownership_statement: The declarant states that the selected AURA code is owned by the declarant and is not subject to a separate third-party license requirement for this transfer decision.

license_and_notices.note: No open-source license is asserted by this attestation. Ownership is retained while the listed Math uses are expressly authorized.

scope.inclusion: Only selected source material that concerns mathematical functionality and is traced to the pinned source manifest.
scope.exclusions: No additional owner exclusions beyond the existing Math transfer boundary; non-mathematical AURA material remains out of scope by project policy.

constraints: Any selected source whose bytes differ from the pinned source manifest must be reconciled before transfer.
This authorization does not transfer AURA host policy, secrets, private data, worker policy, or unrelated domain logic.
Third-party dependencies or embedded third-party material, if later identified, retain their own applicable terms and require separate qualification.
